info.title: PCI Journal Portal API
info.description: Backend for the PCI / DigiPharmed journal portal. All responses use `{ success, message, data, meta }`; errors use `{ success:false, message, code, errors?, requestId }`. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`.

post.summary: Register an Author account (sends an email verification code)
Verify email with the OTP sent at registration
Resend the email verification OTP (generic response)
Step 1 of sign-in: email + password
post.description: When LOGIN_OTP_REQUIRED=true (default) no tokens are issued here: the response contains `challengeId` and an OTP is e-mailed. Complete sign-in with POST /auth/login/verify-otp. Wrong password, unknown email and locked account all return the same 401.

401.description: Not authenticated / invalid credentials or token

post.description: Tokens are single-use and time-limited. Used for password reset and for first-time password setup of invited staff / approved reviewers. All sessions are revoked.

post.summary: Submit a new article (multipart/form-data)
post.description: Fields: `metadata` (JSON string: title, abstract, ethicsStatement, subjectAreaId?, keywords[], authors[], confirmAnonymised=true), file `manuscript` (.docx, required), file `titlePage` (.docx, optional – author details kept out of the reviewer copy). Word count is calculated server-side and articles above the configured limit are flagged (wordLimitExceeded).
